LESSON: THE ENLIGHTENED BEINGS

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: The Enlightened Beings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Enlightened Beings. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE ENLIGHTENED BEINGS
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Enlightened Beings helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE ENLIGHTENED BEINGS
The Enlightened Beings is part of Science learning. Connect every idea to something you can observe.
Use safe examples only. Do not try dangerous experiments without a teacher.
Write definitions in your own words, then add one drawing or real-life example.

PART 1: Name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir

What this means
In this part you learn to name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The Enlightened Beings” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Enlightened Beings is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The Enlightened Beings” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Enlightened Beings to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir.
3. Make one local Kenya example of The Enlightened Beings from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Enlightened Beings: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study The Enlightened Beings?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Enlightened Beings means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: name the Enlightened Krishna, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Enlightened Beings. Beings as per the four faiths Lord Buddha and Lord Mahavir.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
